thread:
mike.support: Escalating to CS — KiteLabs trial onboarding hit a blocker. Welcome emails failed to deliver for 10 org users, SSO not fully configured, and first-run jobs erroring. Customer called; they're worried about launch next week and this looks like a renewal-risk signal.

ops-bot: Alert: mailer-service rate-limit spike (svc: mailer-soft) 2024-06-12T14:02Z. Incident ID: mailer-7891.

mike.support: Quick repro notes I gave support ticket: they attempted provisioning, welcome email send returned 421 rate limit. Support ticket #54821. Log snippet:
```
2024-06-12T13:59:02Z ERROR mailer-soft send: 421 Rate limit exceeded for account kitelabs
```
Customer says they couldn't complete SSO setup because invite emails never arrived.

emma.cs: On it. We need a comms plan and a short-term mitigation. Can you confirm which orgs/users impacted and if any have already converted? Also drop the customer severity and preferred contact window.

mike.support: Impacted orgs: kitelabs-main, kitelabs-dev, kitelabs-research, plus 7 sandbox orgs. No conversions yet — still trial. Customer contact: 9am-3pm PT weekdays. Severity set to P2 by support but they want urgent help. Ticket has email thread and screenshots.

lisa.engineer: Quick mitigation: I can temporarily route sends through backup-smtp for that customer until mailer rate recovers. Will need a thumbs-up from CS and legal OK for sending from alternate domain (we already have consent). ETA 30m to flip for all impacted orgs.

emma.cs: Good plan. Jordan, can you lead the comms? Proposed steps:
- Immediate: flip to backup-smtp (engineering) and resend welcome emails.
- Short-term: schedule an enablement call to walk through SSO and first-run flow.
- Customer comms: apology + clear ETA + link to intake doc + offer to join call.
- Follow-up: capture feedback and add to onboarding runbook.

jordan.csm: I can own the comms and call. Draft reply to customer:
"Hi <name> — sorry about the email issue. We've temporarily routed sends to a backup channel and resent your invites. Can we schedule a 30-min enablement at 10am PT tomorrow to finish SSO? If that works I'll send calendar + a tailored welcome kit." 
I'll send that in 10m.

mike.support: I ran the resend command for the first batch. Command used:
```
./resend_welcome --org=kitelabs-main --force --via=backup-smtp
```
Support ticket updated: attempted resend 14:25 PT, backlog shows 9/10 deliveries successful so far.

emma.cs: Perfect. Jordan — please cc support and engineering on the reply. Also set a watch: if any resend fails, we escalate to eng-sre.

lisa.engineer: Flip complete for all impacted orgs. All resends queued; monitoring for bounces. I'll post back in 15.

ops-bot: Incident update: mailer-7891 rate normalized at 2024-06-12T14:40Z. All systems nominal.

jordan.csm: Sent comms, customer replied confirming 10am PT tomorrow. Calendar invite + welcome kit sent. I've also created an enablement checklist in the CS drive and linked it in the ticket.

emma.cs: Action items recap:
- Jordan: run the 10am enablement call and confirm SSO success + first-run job passes.
- Lisa: monitor for any further delivery bounces and confirm full delivery success.
- Mike: update ticket #54821 with outcome and close once enablement confirmed.
- Emma: draft a short postmortem note for internal onboarding runbook.

mike.support: Acknowledged — will update ticket after call.

emma.cs: Closing loop — this is a prioritized support->CS escalation. Flagged as renewal watch until onboarding completes. Thanks all :raised_hands:
